metaTitle: Mercedes Engine Machining & Rebuild Preparation | Mercedes Garage
metaDescription: Precision engine machining for Mercedes-Benz: cylinder boring, honing, crank grinding, deck surfacing and align honing. In-house facility with manufacturer-grade equipment.
lede: Precision cylinder boring, honing, crankshaft grinding, and deck surfacing for Mercedes-Benz engines — performed in-house to factory tolerances.

blocks.html: At Mercedes Garage, engine machining is the foundation of every rebuild we undertake. Our in-house machine shop is equipped to handle every precision operation required to return your Mercedes-Benz engine to factory specifications.

items: **Main bore align honing** — restores bearing bore alignment and corrects distortion using a dedicated align honing machine
**Cylinder boring and honing** — oversized boring followed by finish honing using manufacturer-grade tools, with **torque plates** to simulate cylinder head clamping stress
**Deck resurfacing** — precision milling of the cylinder block face to ensure a perfectly flat, parallel surface for head gasket sealing
**Crankshaft grinding and micro-polishing** — journal restoration to standard undersizes with a mirror-like finish for bearing longevity
**Full cleaning and inspection** — block and crank are hot-tanked, inspected, and measured with certified equipment before any machining begins

blocks.html: We use dedicated tooling for each Mercedes engine family — including specific torque plates for M156, M157, OM642, and M276 blocks. Modern Mercedes alloys such as **Silitec** (aluminium-silicon) and closed-deck AMG castings are processed with the correct cutter geometry and speeds to prevent surface damage.
Our engine machining service is provided as part of a full engine rebuild. The table below shows our rebuild starting prices — machining is included in these figures.

steps.title: Inspection & Measurement
steps.body: Block and crank are thoroughly cleaned and inspected. All critical dimensions are measured with certified tools to determine the required machining operations.

steps.title: Deburring & Preparation
steps.body: All casting flash and sharp edges are removed using die grinders. This prevents stress risers before precision machining begins.

steps.title: Main Bore Align Honing
steps.body: The main bearing bores are align-honed to correct any distortion and establish a perfectly straight crankshaft axis.

steps.title: Cylinder Boring & Honing
steps.body: Bores are bored to the required oversize, then finish-honed using a torque plate to simulate head bolt clamping force.

steps.title: Deck Resurfacing
steps.body: Block deck is precision-milled to ensure a flat, parallel surface for the head gasket — critical for compression and sealing.

steps.title: Crankshaft Grinding & Polishing
steps.body: Journals are ground to undersize and micro-polished to a mirror finish, followed by oil-hole chamfering and thorough cleaning.

items.q: What does engine machining for a Mercedes-Benz involve?
items.a: It includes main bore align honing, cylinder boring and honing (using torque plates to simulate head bolt stress), deck resurfacing, and crankshaft grinding with micro-polishing. Each operation is performed to factory-specified tolerances using dedicated machine tools.

items.q: Why do you use torque plates when honing Mercedes cylinders?
items.a: Torque plates simulate the clamping force of the cylinder head. This prevents cylinder distortion during honing, ensuring the bores remain perfectly round when the head is torqued in final assembly. This is especially critical for high-compression Mercedes engines.

items.q: Can you machine all Mercedes engine types, including AMG V8s and diesel V6s?
items.a: Yes. Our machine shop is equipped to handle all Mercedes engine families, from four-cylinder M270/OM654 units to V8 M156/M157, V6 OM642, and the V12 M275. We have specific torque plates and tooling for each engine family.

items.q: What precision standards do you work to during machining?
items.a: We work to manufacturer-defined tolerances. For modern Mercedes engines, this includes micron-level accuracy, with H7 fit specifications, radial run-out below 3 µm, and angle tolerances of ±0.025° where specified. Every dimension is verified with certified measuring equipment.

items.q: Do you supply the new parts (pistons, bearings, etc.) or just do the machining?
items.a: We supply and fit all required new components as part of our full engine rebuild service. Machining is performed in-house as the preparation stage for the rebuild, using pistons and bearings supplied by us to ensure correct clearances.
